name: lyric-reader
description: Lyric Reader — read books one sentence at a time, Spotify-lyrics style. Local-first PWA.

paragraphs: A local-first PWA that makes dense books feel like scrolling a feed. Upload a book → text is extracted on-device → read it one sentence at a time, Spotify-lyrics style: the current sentence is huge and bright, the sentences you've passed sit above in muted grey, upcoming ones below. Your thumb sets the pace — swipe, tap, scroll or arrow keys, one sentence per gesture. Each page starts with a clean slate; scroll back and the previous page returns exactly as you left it. Bullets keep a thin hairline linking them to their parent point.

100% local: no accounts, no servers, no uploads. Works fully offline. (One optional extra: ask the AI questions about a passage — that needs your own free Gemini key in Settings, stored on your phone only and never sent anywhere but Google's Gemini API.)
